notes: Includes the merged Android TV improvements: saved default video quality preferences, metadata-validated Next episode, retryable up-next lookups, and stricter update verification of the published SHA-256, package ID, newer version and signing certificate. Fixes CI after hosted runner/SDK updates: supported runner images and an explicitly selected .NET SDK, runtime license notices resolved from the actual restored packs, and Windows publication checks on pull requests. Windows remains an unsigned portable x64 preview with native UI/mpv playback; WebView2 Runtime is required and first Play offers a checksum-verified player download. Android and Windows still share their Movy account/resolver scripts and provider configuration.
